items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: Snooky and Thad and Sonny Cohn

ctx.x: No, Sweets wasn’t in the band, Sweets was gone and Clark Terry was gone. Snooky and Thad and Sonny Cohn, and from time to time, when Joe Newman left, Al Arrons came in. But Joe Newman and Joe Williams left the band on the same day.
